messages.content:
You are grading an AI assistant's answer to a question about a company handbook.

Question: What personal situations does GitLab’s leave policy cover for team members?
Reference answer (written from the handbook): GitLab’s leave policy covers serious health conditions, caring for a family member with a serious health condition, bonding with a newborn or a newly adopted child, and military service.

Passages the assistant was given:
"""
[PTY LTD Benefits > **We've Got You Covered:** > **Time Away & Leave Policies** > **Personal/Carer's Leave**]
Sick and carer's leave (also known as personal leave or personal / carer's leave) lets an employee take time off to help them deal with personal illness, caring responsibilities and family emergencies. Team members will be entitled to personal/carer's leave in accordance with the Fair Work Act 2009 (Cth) as varied from time to time.

Paid Personal/Carer's Leave

Team members are entitled to 10 days of paid personal/carer's leave for each year of continuous service for full-time team members and pro rata for part-time team members based on ordinary hours of work.

- Personal/carer's leave is cumulative and accrues progressively.
- This leave runs concurrently with GitLab's Sick Time policy.

**Eligibility:**

A team member can take paid carer's leave to care for or support a member of their immediate family or household who is sick, injured or has an unexpected emergency.

An immediate family member is a:

- spouse or former spouse
- de facto partner or former de facto partner
- child
- parent
- grandparent
- grandchild
- sibling, or
- child, parent, grandparent, grandchild or sibling of the employee's spouse or de facto partner (or former spouse or de facto partner)

This definition includes step-relations (for example, step-parents and step-children) as well as adoptive relations

- A household member is any person who lives with the employee

**How to Apply:**

[GitLab Singapore Pte Ltd > We've Got You Covered > Financial Security > Personal Accident Insurance]
GitLab provides company-paid Group Personal Accident Policy through Zurich at 36 X Basic Monthly Salary, min $500,000, max $3 million

Additional Protection includes:

- Ambulance cost coverage
- Emergency travel expenses
- Trauma counseling support
- See Accident Policy section of the [GitLab Singapore Benefit Overview](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1OxHW3FxBqSfm6P_cfZ4lZ-WMDHYC27-H/view) for complete details
- Full policy details: [Group Personal Accident Policy](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1W1RlfSFidpvnCOHNlKlmzy_PmJqSACo9/edit)

[GitLab India Private Limited Policy Against Sexual Harassment > Roles and Responsibilities > POLICY AGAINST SEXUAL HARASSMENT > 1.2 Scope]
This policy is applicable to all '*employees*' of GitLab, which for the purpose of this policy shall include all permanent and temporary team members (including during any probation period), interns, and also contract workers or vendors/consultants providing services for GitLab and the policy applies to any allegations of sexual harassment made against an '*employee*', if the conduct occurred during the course of their work for GitLab.

Working remotely means that the majority of our interactions are by video call or written communication, such as email or shared documents, although there are exceptions to this, including customer meetings, company summits, attending conferences, and team meetups. This policy is applicable to all instances where individuals covered by this policy have occasion to interact on a work-related basis (e.g., in vehicles, third party premises, off-site meetings and public venues). GitLab will not tolerate any form of sexual harassment, if engaged in by its team members, customers or suppliers or any other business associates, if such conduct occurs whether in-person, or from any other place from which a team member may be working remotely.

[GitLab Korea Limited Benefits > We've Got You Covered > Growing Family Leaves > Short-Term Child Care Leave - New as of August 2026]
**Effective 20 August 2026**, team members may draw on their Child Care Leave entitlement in shorter weekly increments to address short-term care gaps, rather than taking the full leave in 30-day increments.

This option is designed to accommodate situations such as school holidays, unexpected school or daycare closures, or a child's sudden illness — circumstances where a full month of leave is not needed.

Leave Entitlement

- Leave may be taken in 1-week or 2-week increments
- This benefit can only be used once per calendar year
- Time taken in weekly increments is deducted from your total unused Child Care Leave entitlement (up to 1 year, or 1.5 years if applicable) — it is not additional leave
- Eligibility conditions remain the same: child must be 8 years old or younger, or in second grade or below

How to Apply

1. Provide advance notice as early as possible — 30 days is preferred where circumstances allow
2. Contact the Absence Management team at leaves@gitlab.com

[GitLab Inc (US) Benefits > We've Got You Covered > Leave Policy & Accommodations]
**All Leave Types:** Find complete information on US leave policies (including FMLA, CFRA, and state-specific leaves) on our [Leave of Absence - US handbook page](/handbook/people-policies/leave-of-absence/us/).

**Parental Leave:** See our [Parental Leave information](/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/#parental-leave) for policy details and application instructions.

**Pregnancy Accommodations:** You may need [reasonable accommodations](/handbook/people-policies/inc-usa/#reasonable-accommodation) during pregnancy. For details on GitLab's [Pregnancy Accommodation](/handbook/people-policies/inc-usa/#pregnancy-accommodation) policy, refer to our [Individuals with Disabilities policy](/handbook/people-policies/inc-usa/#individuals-with-disabilities-policy).

The [U.S. Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA)](https://www.dol.gov/general/topic/workhours/vacation_leave) does not require payment for time not worked, such as vacations, sick leave or federal or other holidays.

[GitLab Korea Limited Benefits > We've Got You Covered > Growing Family Leaves]
GitLab Korea provides **comprehensive parental leave benefits** that go beyond statutory requirements, ensuring you have the time and financial security to focus on your family during these important moments. The information below outlines the statutory entitlement for each leave, team members may be eligible for [GitLab Parental Leave policy](/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/#parental-leave) in addition to their statutory coverage.
"""

Assistant's answer:
"""
GitLab's personal/carer's leave policy covers personal illness, caring responsibilities, and family emergencies [1]. Specifically, it allows time off to care for an immediate family or household member who is sick, injured, or experiencing an unexpected emergency [1].
"""

First write one sentence of reasoning, then grade three things:
- correctness: "correct" if the answer states the key information in the reference answer without contradicting it (extra correct detail is fine); "partial" if it gets part of it or is vague; "incorrect" if it is wrong, contradicts the reference, or does not answer.
- refused: true if the assistant declined or said it does not know, instead of answering.
- faithful: true if every factual claim in the answer is supported by the passages above (ignore whether it matches the reference). An answer that only refuses counts as faithful.
The grades must agree with your reasoning.
Return JSON with the reasoning first: {"reason": "one sentence", "correctness": "correct" | "partial" | "incorrect", "refused": true/false, "faithful": true/false}
